name: Apex 2-Person Ultralight Tent
description: Ultralight 3-season backpacking tent with dual vestibules, durable ripstop sil-nylon rainfly, and anodized aluminum poles. Weighs only 3.2 lbs.

name: Summit Ridge 65L Expedition Backpack
description: Ergonomic multi-day internal-frame pack with adjustable suspension, integrated high-visibility rain cover, sleeping bag compartment, and hydration bladder sleeve.

name: Glacier Peak -10°F Down Sleeping Bag
description: Cold-weather expedition mummy bag packed with 800-fill hydrophobic goose down, insulated draft collar, contoured hood, and waterproof compression sack.

name: TrailBreeze 30°F Synthetic Sleeping Bag
description: All-around camping sleeping bag with moisture-resistant synthetic insulation, semi-rectangular cut for extra shoulder room, and snag-free two-way zipper.

name: Timberline All-Weather Hiking Boots
description: Waterproof nubuck leather boots featuring breathable waterproof membrane, shock-absorbing EVA midsole, and high-traction Vibram rubber lug outsoles.

name: Cascade Carbon Trekking Poles (Pair)
description: Ultralight 100% carbon fiber 3-section telescoping poles with natural moisture-wicking cork grips, padded wrist straps, and quick-twist lever locks.

name: Wilderness Roaster Multi-Fuel Camp Stove
description: Versatile backpacking stove capable of running on canister isobutane or white gas. Boils 1 liter of water in 3.5 minutes with micro-flame simmering control.

name: HydroFlow Gravity Water Filter System (3L)
description: Fast 0.1-micron hollow fiber membrane gravity filter that removes 99.999% of bacteria and protozoa without pumping. Purifies 3L in under 4 minutes.

name: Solaris 500 Lumen Rechargeable Headlamp
description: IPX6 waterproof headlamp with 500 lumens peak output, USB-C fast charging, red night-vision LED, tilting hinge, and up to 40 hours runtime on low.

name: Alpine Shield 3-Layer GORE-TEX Jacket
description: Technical windproof and waterproof mountain hardshell jacket featuring 3-layer GORE-TEX fabric, underarm ventilation pit zips, and helmet-compatible storm hood.

name: BaseCamp Heavy-Duty 45Qt Rotomolded Cooler
description: Rugged rotomolded ice chest with 3-inch pressure-injected polyurethane insulation that keeps ice frozen for up to 7 days. Certified bear-resistant.

name: MountainPro 14-in-1 Titanium Multi-Tool
description: Rustproof titanium pocket multi-tool with spring-loaded needle-nose pliers, wire cutters, 420HC locking blade, wood saw, bottle/can opener, and bit driver.
